description: Why: article size limits must be consistent across all ingestion paths to prevent a malformed large article accepted by suck_pull from later failing in run_pipeline or overwhelming the ingestion queue byte budget. What: suck_pull.rs defines MAX_ARTICLE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024 (5 MiB) while ingestion.rs enforces a 1 MiB limit in check_ingest. An article between 1 MiB and 5 MiB will be fetched, buffered, and submitted to check_ingest where it will be rejected. The wasted network fetch and buffer allocation cannot be avoided unless the limits match.
title: suck_pull 5 MiB limit inconsistent with ingestion 1 MiB limit
